description_en: Removes a Resource Directory (RD) member account from a Bastionhost instance. You must remove all assets of the member account from Bastionhost before you call this operation
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost remove-instance-rd-member --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --member-id 1597141696147832 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveInstanceRdMember

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:

parameters.help_en:
